campaign_objective: Survive the two-front German and Soviet existential threat, leverage powerful monarchist or Baltic alliance focus paths, defend core river lines (Vistula and Romanian Bridgehead), and counter-attack to conquer Berlin and Moscow.

meta_mechanics.focus_options: Monarchist paths (Kingdom of Poland / Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth) grant huge core territory, population, and industry across the Baltic and Belarus.
meta_mechanics.romanian_bridgehead: Dense fort line anchored on the Dniester River and Carpathian mountains, keeping supply route to Allied trade open via the Black Sea.
meta_mechanics.cavalry_and_mobile_encirclements: Cavalry with high speed and support artillery to slip through gaps in advancing German lines and sever East Prussia and Silesia supply rails.
